title: Chapter 421: Master Of Formation
content:
Chapter 421: Master Of Formation

Soon, the message was sent.

The Chaos Realm fell into a brief panic for a moment.

A powerful enemy invades?

If this news had not been sent from the deserted city, no creature would have believed it.

Huangcheng did not inform everyone of the basis of this news.

Inside the Heavenly Demon Clan in the Chaos Realm.

"Clan leader, what do you think?"

The powerful people of the Tiande Clan immediately gathered together and convened an emergency meeting.

The demons were unsure of their minds and looked at the leader of the Tiandemon clan.

Feeling the uneasy eyes of the demons, the patriarch of the Heavenly Demon Clan narrowed his eyes slightly and looked towards the human race.

"What a panic? There are tall people holding on to it when the sky falls."

The human race is so powerful now that it will definitely be ahead by the time being. The pressure on their Heavenly Demon race should not be so great.

Hearing the words of the patriarch of the Heavenly Demon Clan, the demons nodded slightly, and felt that it made sense.

"By the way, is there any news about those two guys Qinghai and Xuansi?"

The leader of the Tian Yao Clan suddenly thought of this and asked immediately.

Nowadays, troubled times are about to arise. If the Heavenly Demon Clan can have the four symbols of the Heavenly Demon Clan, its strength will inevitably be greatly improved, and the Heavenly Demon Clan will also have a little bit of self-protection.

This is what comes to mind from his perspective.

But how did he know what kind of enemy the Chaos Realm will face?

I'm afraid that all the creatures in the Chaos Realm will be ants except for the deserted city.

"Clan leader, not yet."

The powerful man from the Heavenly Demon Clan shook his head, his expression also a little dim.

"That's how it is."

The leader of the Tian Yao Clan no longer asked about it. He still firmly believed in his heart that this generation would inevitably gather the four symbols of the Tian Yao, which was a kind of intuition from the heart.

On the other side, another former strong clan.

Holy Spirit.

The former Holy Spirit clan had a transcendent status and ignored the world, just like a peerless beauty living in seclusion in the mountains and forests, arrogant and noble.

And the Holy Spirit tribe is indeed ignoring the world because he has already made a fuss.

Anyway, what he said doesn't count.

The entire Holy Spirit clan's senior management did not respond to the news released by Huangcheng, and did not cause any ripples.

Obviously, the Holy Spirit Clan and the Heavenly Demon Clan both chose to be low-key and silently retreated to the human race. Anyway, the human race was in front of him, so what were you afraid of?

Aren’t your human race invincible in the world? Since there are strong races invading the Chaos Realm, then you can go.

And these two once strong races are like this, and those slightly weaker races are even harder to express any opinions. Most of them are attached to the human race. Basically, they do whatever the human race asks them to do. What.

In this way, under the influence of the powerful human forces, the entire Chaos Realm basically unified the front.

At the same time, extremely far away from the Chaos Realm, the birthplace of the disaster - the Land of Gods.

The six giant pillars of the sky penetrate the sky and the earth, like a god above, quietly looking down at the countless devout worshipers below.

These worshippers have a strong aura. Although they have become powerful, they have lost their minds when they are affected by these chaotic auras.

"I have calculated that place, called Chaos Realm."

A sound came from a giant pillar.

"Chaos Realm? It seems to be a little bit of an impression."

"Yes, we sent some messy bloodlines and believers there a long time ago, and now they are all dead."

"It seems that it's right there."

Several giant pillars flickered and darker, and their tone was full of hostility towards the Chaos Realm.

Of course, the one who made them the most hostile was Lu Daosheng.

But they didn't know where Lu Daosheng was, and they didn't know how strong Lu Daosheng was.

If they knew a little, they would probably not have done such a ridiculous thing.

Eliminate the Chaos Realm and force Lu Daosheng to appear.

That's their purpose.

They have sensed that there is a more or less relationship between the Chaos Realm and Lu Daosheng.

But that's all.

They didn't even know Lu Daosheng's name.

On this day, the land of the gods shone brightly, and the six giant pillars that lead to the sky all let out a deafening roar.

The space twisted and the earth trembled.

Buzz —

A huge black hole appeared above the land of the gods. Immediately afterwards, countless powerful people from the land of the gods slowly took off with numb expressions and entered the black hole.

But there are also some auras that are not only amazing, but also preserve rational existence.

Those are the elites of the land of the gods.

"Go, turn the Chaos Realm to the sky and become one of the countless victorious realms of my Gods."

"Affect your order, Lord God."

The black hole did not disappear, but countless powerful people from the land of gods continued to enter, which would surely be a fierce battle for the Chaos Realm.

At this time, the Chaos Realm also felt the abnormal movement from outside the sky.

A black dot emerged out of thin air. It was not noticeable at first, but gradually, the black dot became larger and larger, and continued to expand, and finally expanded into a huge black hole at an incredible speed.

The black hole was pitch black, and there was a manic and chaotic breath from time to time.

In the deserted city, Lu Xue raised her white neck and looked up at the sky. A dark light appeared in her bright eyes, and her eyebrows were frowned.

"So fast."

On the side, Shi Tianzhi took a deep breath, bowed to Lu Xue, and said, "Miss Lu Xue, I will leave the safety of the wasteland city and the Chaos Realm to you."

"I have some private matters below, so I'll take my leave first."

After saying that, Shi Tianzhi hurriedly left the city lord's mansion.

Lu Xue ignored Shi Tianzhi when she left, but went to a certain place in the inner city.

Nowadays, there are many talents in the deserted city, and facing the invasion of the earth, some people naturally cannot be idle.

Dongdongdongdongdongdong!

Lu Xue came to the door of an elegant courtyard and started knocking directly.

Seeing that there was no movement inside, Lu Xue's face was not very good, and the knocking force in her hand pushed a little harder.

Dongdongdongdongdongdong!

There was another knock on the door, and finally there was movement inside the door.

"Who? Is it still possible to sleep in broad daylight?!"

The door opened from inside, and an old face came into view.

The old man in the courtyard was wearing a wide white robe, with white eyebrows and white hair, like a retired immortal.

But at this moment, the old man couldn't help but be slightly stunned when he saw Lu Xue.

"Lu, Lu Xuexiao,,,,"

Before the old man could finish his words, Lu Xue had already stepped in.

"Zhen Qingyang, when is it now? You still have the heart to sleep? Do you really treat the wasteland city as your place to retire?"

After Lu Xue entered the courtyard, her face looked extremely bad.

Of course, she mostly pretends.

The old man's name is Zhen Qingyang, and he was a master of Zhen Daosheng brought back from a long time ago when he traveled outside.

How could someone who can be favored by his father be an ordinary person?

Lu Xue also believed that this person's attainment in formation was probably extremely high.

Zhen Qingyang smiled with his old face on his shoulder, but did not refute anything, "Miss Lu is really shining when he can come to this house."
